args.subject: Update Confirmation: Billing Address & Late Fee Refund
args.body:
Dear Accounts Team,

This email confirms the following updates to Litware Ltd (C-8735):

1. **Billing Contact Updated:** Invoices will now be sent to **accounts@litware.ai** (previously ap-desk-d57u@litware.ai). This change is effective immediately.

2. **Late Fee Refund Processed:** A refund of **240** (late fee) has been initiated and will reflect in your next statement.

Thank you for reaching out. Let us know if you require further assistance.
